title: AI-Based Interactive Learning Assistant for Classroom Education
bg: Teachers often have to manage large classrooms and cannot give personalized attention to every student. Students may hesitate to ask basic questions during lectures.
desc: There is a gap in real-time, personalized assistance for students in physical classroom environments without relying solely on screen-based screen-time.
challenge: Design an interactive physical device that can assist students with queries, quizzes, or basic tutoring during or after class, reducing the teacher's load.
solution: A smart hardware assistant (e.g., a desktop bot or smart speaker prototype) that can process educational queries, provide hints, and guide the student through problem-solving.
features:
- Essential: Voice or text input, educational query processing, audio/visual feedback.
- Optional: Progress tracking, offline local knowledge base, integration with a teacher's dashboard.
hardware: Raspberry Pi, microphone, speaker, LCD/OLED display, buttons.
deliverables: Prototype, demonstration of tutoring capability, source code, system diagram, testing results, brief documentation.
eval: Functionality, technical implementation, educational value, usability.
ethics: Must not store identifying data of minors without consent. Responses must be age-appropriate and safe.
